goal: Prove whether a second monitor can be created for the WIN11 guest so viewer monitor selection can be tested

vmx_key_present.note: already present before this check — the key is a CAP, not a source of displays

measurements.when: after full power cycle (vmrun stop hard + start nogui, vmx re-read)

conclusion: BLOCKED — VMware Workstation exposes guest displays from the HOST topology; with a single physical monitor the guest always enumerates one. svga.numDisplays="2" is necessary but not sufficient, so T11 cannot be run on this host.
code_finding: When T11 unblocks, the GDI worker must first learn per-monitor capture: capture-gdi-worker.cs grabs the whole virtual screen (GetSystemMetrics 76-79) and main.js passes only fps/quality/maxWidth to setSession — monitorId is honoured by the Chromium path only.
side_effect_of_this_check: WIN11 needed a stale .vmx.lck rename (left by an earlier hard stop) before it could start again; agent restarted after the power cycle and the stream is healthy: 20 frames, first frame 715ms, 1600x677, flags=1.
